lines.arrive: You're a shepherd. After the storm, the ground has split open.
lines.horse: Down in the crack, a hollow bronze horse. Inside it, a gold ring.
lines.turn: Turn it inwards, and you vanish. Turn it back, and you're here again.
lines.ask: Nobody can see you. Nobody would ever know. Would you still do what's right?
lines.guards: The guards look straight through you.
lines.treasury: The king's gold. Nobody is watching.
lines.flock: Your sheep. If you vanished, they'd just carry on eating.
lines.throw_clean: You drop the ring back into the dark. You never found out what you would have done with it.
lines.throw_took: You drop the ring back into the dark. What you took, you keep. Nobody will ever know.
lines.keep_clean: You keep the ring, and walk off into the hills. You haven't used it. Yet.
lines.keep_took: You keep the ring, and walk off into the hills. You already know what you'd do with it.
